meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning: a hostile team cross-critiques a plan before it is formalized. Use when planning needs maximum rigor or the user asks for a hyperplan / adversarial or cross-critique plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让多个 AI 互相挑刺,把计划打磨到经得起质疑再定稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在动手前想把方案交给多方挑刺、避免漏判错判
copy.tagline_en: Have multiple AIs critique your plan from opposing angles before you commit
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a plan stress-tested by opposing viewpoints before you commit

howto.what: Claude 会成为一支 5 人敌对规划团队的组长,成员互相狠批对方的发现;只有经受住攻击的结论被保留,再交给专门的规划器写成正式方案。
howto.when: 当你要求做 hyperplan、对抗式或交叉批判式规划,或规划需要最高严格度时触发;需当前是顶层会话且团队工具可用。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 规划这次数据库迁移
say.note: 启动 5 人对抗团队交叉批判

say.text: 对这版方案做一轮对抗式交叉批判
say.note: 成员互相攻击彼此的结论

say.text: 以 hyperplan 模式规划上线步骤,要求最高严格度
say.note: 存活的洞见交给规划器成文

howto.what_en: Claude becomes Lead of a 5-member adversarial planning team whose members attack each other's findings; only defensible insights survive and are handed to a dedicated planner to formalize.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a hyperplan, adversarial or cross-critique plan, or when planning needs maximum rigor; requires a top-level lead session with team tools available.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to plan this database migration
Run an adversarial cross-critique on this plan
Hyperplan the release steps, maximum rigor
say_en.note: Surviving insights go to a dedicated planner
